title: Keep my progress

intro.guest: Your save lives on this device only. Link an account to keep it safe and play it anywhere.
intro.linked: Your save is kept with your account. Sign in on any device to pick it up.

loadFailed: Your account could not be checked just now. Your save is safe on this device.

demo.note: Demo Mode: these sign-ins are fake. They never reach Google or Apple and only last as long as this tab.

unavailable: Google and Apple sign-in are on their way. Your save stays safe on this device until then.
unavailableOne: {{provider}} sign-in is on its way. Your save stays safe on this device until then.

linked.heading: Linked accounts
linked.confirmHint: This save stays on this device and with any other linked account.
linked.confirmLast: This is your only linked account. Without it, this save lives on this device only.

status.inUse: That {{provider}} account already keeps another save.
status.invalidToken: {{provider}} could not confirm it was you. Please try again.
status.unavailable: {{provider}} sign-in is not available right now. Your save is safe on this device.
status.offline: You seem to be offline. Your save is safe; try again once you are connected.
status.failed: That did not go through. Your save is safe; please try again.
status.signedIn: Welcome back. Your {{venue}} save is on the table.
status.sameSave: You are already playing this save.
status.keptGuest: You are playing this device's save. The account save stays with your account.
status.swapFailed: You are signed in, but your save has not reached the table yet.

switch.open: Saved on another device? Sign in
switch.title: Sign in to a kept save
switch.hint: Pick the account your other save is linked to.

choice.title: Choose a save
choice.subtitle: Saves are never merged. Pick the one to play from now on.
choice.warnDevice: The account save stays with your account. This device plays on as a guest.
choice.warnAccount: This device's guest save will be left behind and cannot be recovered.

prompt.title: Keep this save safe
prompt.ascension: A new venue is worth keeping. Link Google or Apple so this save follows you.
prompt.playtime: That is a lot of fine play. Link Google or Apple so this save follows you.
